en.t: This poem was written in pale ink.

units.source_text: 兵部卿亲王看了答诗，想道：写得更有风情些才好。

en.t: When Prince Hyobukyo saw the reply poem, he thought that it would have been better if it had been written with a little more elegance.

units.source_text: 他那色情之心略觉美中不足。

en.t: His amorous heart felt it was somewhat lacking in charm.

units.source_text: 这一天，各方面送给玉鬘的香荷包甚多，式样都很美丽。

en.t: That day, many scented sachets were sent to Tamakazura from all sides, and their designs were all very beautiful.

units.source_text: 玉鬘往日长年沉沦的痛苦，现已影迹全无。

en.t: The suffering Tamakazura had endured through long years of hardship had now vanished without a trace.

units.source_text: 她正在欣欣向荣，坐享厚福。

en.t: She was now flourishing and enjoying abundant good fortune.

units.source_text: 她安得不想：但愿太政大臣勿萌异志，免得我受人毁伤。

en.t: How could she help thinking: may the Grand Minister never conceive other intentions, so that I may be spared from being harmed by others.
